instruction: A freestanding stone archway: two stone piers supporting a semicircular arch made of wedge-shaped voussoir blocks, with a keystone at the top and a flat coping course above. Meter-scale, believable for a pedestrian entry.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a stone archway. A freestanding stone archway: two stone piers supporting a semicircular arch made of wedge-shaped voussoir blocks, with a keystone at the top and a flat coping course above. Meter-scale, believable for a pedestrian entry. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
